title: cyamus luteus
intro: Cyamus luteus, commonly known as "golden seed", is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyamus luteus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
